title: An Open Label Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of BOR15001L7 for the Treatment of Cold Sores in Patients With Recurrent Herpes Labialis
brief_summary: BOR15001L7 is a natural product. The primary objective of this study is to demonstrate its non-inferiority to docosanol 10% based on the healing time of cold sores in patients with recurrent herpes labialis.
